description: Oil and Gas Pre-2016 Waste Disposal Sites is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by British Columbia Energy Regulator. Polygons indicating drilling waste disposal sites as generated from upstream oil and gas operations. Drilling waste disposal areas include portions of the wellsite or remote sump where drilling wastes have been buried, spread on land, or mixed into soil. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher British Columbia Energy Regulator. Its tags are BC Energy Regulator, BCER, Disposal, Drilling, Energy Regulator. It offers 3 resource(s) in KML, MULTIPLE, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Access Only. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
